description: This file defines the Assert class, which implements a mini-language assert operation within the Apache OFBiz framework. It evaluates a set of conditionals, logs error messages if conditions fail, and manages assertions within a method execution context.

classes.name: Assert
classes.description: Represents an assertion operation in the mini-language, evaluating conditions and logging errors if assertions fail.

classes.name: Assert.AssertFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Assert instances from XML elements.

methods.name: Assert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Assert object based on XML configuration and the enclosing simple method.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the assertion by evaluating all conditions; logs error messages upon failures.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Assert object for debugging purposes.
